cypher: MATCH (r:DLRepository)-[:DL_CONTAINS_FILE]->(f:DLFile) WHERE r.dataset=$dataset AND r.repo=$repo AND f.path=$path WITH r,f,[line IN split(f.content,'\n') WHERE trim(line) STARTS WITH 'import ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'from ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'using ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH '#include' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'require('] AS imports RETURN CASE WHEN size(imports)=0 THEN 'no matching import declarations' ELSE reduce(s='',x IN imports[0..5] | s+CASE WHEN s='' THEN '' ELSE ' | ' END+trim(x)) END AS entity,'Explicit import-line extraction from '+f.path AS fact,[r.id,f.id] AS evidence_ids
